name: trait-S04-topline-arched-a
refs: Our signed young S04, Hiljan (project-owned): edit THIS picture. Its back line is the 'level' look.
prompt: Edit this picture. Keep everything exactly as it is: the same creature, head, face, ears, eyes, tail, legs and feet in the same places, the same size, colours, light, brush and the same magenta background and shadow. Change ONLY the line of the back between the shoulders and the hips: make it 'arched', a clear gentle arch, the back rising in the middle above the level of the shoulders and hips, like a cat's rounded back at rest. The belly line follows it a little. No other change, no text, no glow.
